test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The laboratory will have double-checked the reagents by dawn.

options.text: The reagents have been double-checked by dawn.
The reagents will have been double-checked by dawn.
The reagents will be double-checked by dawn.
The reagents would have been double-checking by dawn.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The laboratory will have double-checked the reagents by dawn."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the reagents" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will have double-checked" to "will have been double-checked" (future perfect passive).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "by dawn" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The reagents will have been double-checked by dawn."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The reagents have been double-checked by dawn." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"The reagents will be double-checked by dawn." – Incorrect tense (future simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The reagents would have been double-checking by dawn." – Incorrect form (future perfect continuous).
